title: Spanish Empanada with Potato and Aromatic Herbs
description: A traditional Spanish empanada filled with tender potatoes and flavorful aromatic herbs. Perfect as a side dish or light meal.
instructions: Roll out the empanada dough and cut into desired shapes.
In a pan, sauté the diced potatoes with chopped green onion and aromatic herbs until tender.
Place a spoonful of the potato mixture onto one half of the dough.
Fold the other half of the dough over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops with olive oil and bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
